fiscal_fy2024_25.scope: statewide financial constraints and contingent liabilities; do not allocate any fraction to electricity without project-level evidence
caveats: Statewide liabilities are not project funding, not a financeable budget and cannot be added to contingent guarantee stocks.
Post-audit and originally reported figures are alternate measures of the same fiscal position, not additional separate liabilities.
CAG describes guarantees as contingent; they are not automatically invoked cash liabilities.
No power-specific KSEBL guarantee amount is established by the statewide total.

accounting_boundaries.label: Whole-system economic cost
accounting_boundaries.meaning: All incremental lifecycle resources used regardless of financier
accounting_boundaries.separate_from: Cash transfer between Kerala, KSEBL and Union

accounting_boundaries.label: Kerala exchequer
accounting_boundaries.meaning: Actual state grants, equity, eligible guarantees invoked, state debt service and support costs
accounting_boundaries.separate_from: KSEBL own-fund investment and contingent uncalled guarantee face value

accounting_boundaries.label: KSEBL utility accounts
accounting_boundaries.meaning: Utility capex, debt service, purchase expenses, opex and revenue flows
accounting_boundaries.separate_from: Consolidated Fund actual expenditure and consumer tariffs

accounting_boundaries.label: Union / central-PSU
accounting_boundaries.meaning: Eligible grants, central utility investment and programme funding per verified sanction
accounting_boundaries.separate_from: Announced national scheme size or hypothetical eligibility

accounting_boundaries.label: Private/development finance
accounting_boundaries.meaning: Contract-specific equity, loan drawdowns, guarantees and required returns
accounting_boundaries.separate_from: De-risking treated as a free government subsidy

accounting_boundaries.label: Consumers and communities
accounting_boundaries.meaning: Tariffs, own capex, avoided bills, resilience/access benefits and distribution

release_checks: Proposed allocation != release != expenditure != full economic cost.
Separate agency-level outlay from Kerala treasury fiscal responsibility.
Annual flow from year-end stock; original and post-audit are not additive.
Cash support, repayable loan, equity and uninvoked guarantee are different instruments.
Fiscal deficit does not measure room for project funding on its own.
No 2040 cost or funding percentages without admitted project register, real price year, contracts and source-linked risk assignment.
